title: Bathroom scales
prompt: A labelled scale teaching model of the mechanical bathroom scales on pages 24 and 25 uses a removable test mass. Weigh loads the platform, moving its four third-class levers and calibrating plate down to extend the main spring. Add weight increases extension and dial reading. Unload removes all masses so the main spring raises the platform and returns the dial to zero. See-through shows platform levers, main spring, calibrating plate, first-class crank, dial spring and rack-and-pinion dial drive. Show small platform travel and larger dial movement. Do not substitute an electronic load cell or claim a source-proved manual zero adjuster.
blurb: A teaching model uses removable test masses to show how four platform levers stretch a spring and turn a mechanical dial.
adaptation: Enlarged teaching mechanism and removable test masses. Illustrative spring rate, geometry and dial calibration.

sourceEvidence.1998: Saved primary OCR, printed pages 24-25, raw indices 27-28.
sourceEvidence.2016: Saved primary OCR, printed pages 24-25, raw indices 25-26.

mechanism: Four third-class platform levers, calibrating plate, main spring, first-class crank, dial spring, rack and pinion. Automatic return on unloading. No manual zero adjuster or electronics.
